notes.market: Appalachian Power (AEP) south and central, Mon Power and Potomac Edison (FirstEnergy) north; ~6.3 cents/kWh average industrial. 2025 amendment to the high-impact-industrial-facility statute explicitly covers high impact data centers and authorizes behind-the-meter generation.
notes.parcels: One statewide composite service covers all 55 counties, so no county overrides are needed.
